title: Contribution guidelines and dataset format
text: Single cell data formatted SingleCellExperiment object named sce contains following slots: colData: observations metadata. rowData: marker metadata. assays: marker expression levels per cell. colPairs (optional): neighborhood information.

title: Contribution guidelines and dataset format
text: colData entry SingleCellExperiment object DataFrame contains observation metadata; .e., cells, slides, tissue, patients, …. recommended column names prefix indicates level observation (e.g. cell_, slide_ , tissue_, patient_, tumor_). following columns required: image_name /image_number: unique image (ablated ROI) name, respectively number. map image_name/image_number column(s) metadata images masks objects. cell_number: integer representing cell numbers. map values cell segmentation masks. cell_id: unique cell identifier defined {image_number _ cell_number} (e.g., 7_138). cell_x cell_y: position cell centroid image. columns used SpatialCoords converting SpatialExperiment object. addition, colnames(sce) set colData(sce)$cell_id.

title: Contribution guidelines and dataset format
text: rowData entry SingleCellExperiment DataFrame contains marker (protein, RNA, probe) information. following columns required rowData entry: channel: unique integer maps channels associated multichannel images. metal: metal isotope used detection, formatted { ChemicalSymbol IsotopeMass} (e.g., Y89, In115, Yb176, Bi209). name: marker name used publication describes dataset. full_name: full marker name. short_name: abbreviated marker name, preferably following official UniProt nomenclature. full_name short_name columns, following guidelines apply: short_name, dashes, dots spaces removed replaced underscores. post-translationally modified proteins: Prefix full_name modification type (e.g., phospho-, methyl-) suffix modified aminoacids (e.g., [S28]). Prefix short_name abbreviation modification type (e.g., p_, me_) indicate modified aminoacids, unless possible confusion another target dataset. ‘full_name’ ‘short_name’ examples commonly used markers addition, rownames(sce) set rowData(sce)$short_name.

title: Contribution guidelines and dataset format
text: assays slot SingleCellExperiment contains counts matrices representing marker expression levels per cell channel. least contain counts matrix raw ion counts. assays slot can also contain additional matrices commonly used counts transformations, counts transformations used publication describes dataset. counts transformations must documented .R function used load dataset. title: Accessing IMC datasets
text: imcdatasets package provides access publicly available datasets generated using imaging mass cytometry (IMC) (Giesen et al. 2014). IMC technology enables measurement 50 markers tissue sections resolution 1 μm\mu mGiesen et al. (2014). classical processing pipelines, ImcSegmentationPipeline steinbock, multichannel images segmented generate cells masks. masks used extract single cell features multichannel images. dataset imcdatasets composed three elements can retrieved separately: 1. Single-cell data form SingleCellExperiment SpatialExperiment class object (named sce.rds). 2. Multichannel images form CytoImageList class object (named images.rds). 3. Cell segmentation masks form CytoImageList class object (named masks.rds).
